summary: Inovio Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with Piper Sandler for a public offering of common stock and warrants. The offering priced at $0.95 per share with warrants to purchase two shares at $1.10 each, raising approximately $18.3 million net. The underwriter exercised its option for additional warrants. This is a routine equity financing under an existing shelf registration, not a special-situation event.
